pid.description: The PID of the job, equal to its process-group id (job-runtime.adoc, Launch report).

process_started_at.description: The start instant of the process, on the clock of the operating system.

confinement.description: The confinement applied to the job (job-runtime.adoc, Linux Filesystem Confinement and macOS Confinement); unavailable when no ruleset could be applied.

landlock_abi.description: The Landlock ABI version of the applied ruleset; null when none was applied.

git_metadata.description: For a worker: enforced when the launcher states that the git directory of the project and the .git link file of every linked worktree are unwritable for the job, unenforced otherwise; absent for every other kind (job-runtime.adoc, Git Metadata).
